title: Chicken and Black Soy Bean Soup
ldName: Chicken and Black Soy Bean Soup
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 free range chicken, cut into 8 pieces
100 gram dry black soy bean, soaked in cold water overnight and drained
2 medium (or 1 big) carrot, peeled and cut into slices
ldInstructionsRaw: Place all ingredients in a soup pot and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 to 2 hours or until chicken is tender and fully cooked and the bean is soft to your likeness. Adjust salt and sugar as needed.
Remove from heat and serve warm.
